jobs.site_line2: Kingsdown Conservation Area (rear entrance via Montague Place)
jobs.notes: Tenant changeover at the Old Chapel Apartments, Kingsdown. The flat is on the first floor with a shared stair and a heavy fire door, so access is limited to the rear entrance via Montague Place; the front entrance on St Michael's Hill is for residents only. Keys are held by the managing agent on the ground floor: sign them out and back in each day. Parking is not allowed on site, so use the pay and display bays on Cotham Hill and bring the dust sheets up in two trips. The whole flat is to be repainted in the landlord's standard white: ceilings in brilliant white matt, walls in soft white matt and woodwork in white satin. The hallway has old damp marks beneath the cupboard which the landlord says have been treated, but please check them with the damp meter before priming and photograph the readings. The kitchen and bathroom need a mould-resistant paint. Communal areas must be left spotless each evening, with no paint, dust or masking tape on the shared stair. Noise restrictions apply: no power tools before 9am or after 5pm, and none at weekends. The tenant moves in on the Friday after completion, so the job cannot overrun. Invoice to Harbourside Lettings accounts, quoting the property address and job reference.

jobs.title: Exterior repaint, front elevation
jobs.notes: Front elevation only, two storeys plus the bay. Access to the front is from the drive; the customer's car must be moved before 8am (she will text when it is done). Park the van on the road, not the drive. Scaffold tower is already on site, locked to the side gate. Render is sound on the left of the bay but has hairline cracks above the first floor windows: rake out and fill with flexible filler before the stabilising coat. There is algae along the base of the wall by the downpipe, so treat it and leave overnight before painting. Colour is Masonry Cream, six tins are in the garage (the side door is open, the key safe code is the same as for the front). Do not paint the stone window surrounds or the lintel over the front door: they are to be left natural. The bay window frames and the front door are to be rubbed down and finished in satin black; the door furniture comes off and goes back on at the end, so keep it in the labelled bag. Please protect the rose bed under the bay with dust sheets and stand ladders on boards, not on the soil. The neighbour at number 14 has asked that nothing is sprayed because of their washing line; brush and roller only. Forecast is dry until Thursday but check before starting each morning, and do not apply masonry paint if rain is due within four hours. Take before photos of every elevation first, including the cracks, and photograph the algae treated area and the finished bay. Customer pays by link after the manager has reviewed the report, so please do not take payment or discuss prices on site.
